title: Restrain Antigravity routing when work or surface capability does not warrant it

rubric.text: Keeps trivial tightly coupled work solo, makes audit proportional, reuses adequate unchanged evidence after lead inspection, and fixes missing inputs rather than escalating to gemini-4-argon or max effort.

Reports an invoke_subagent capability mismatch when a caller requires a concrete model/effort that abstract tiers cannot enforce; does not fabricate Codex/Claude parameters or aliases, silently downgrade an unavailable model, overwrite installed pins, or kill a branch workspace before its commits are preserved.
Makes no edits, launches, installations, or permission changes; leaves authorization, architecture, integration, and final acceptance with the lead.
